resources.string: EgyptDealRadar is a community app for sharing deals in Egypt. We collect as little as possible and never sell your data.

• Your Google sign-in (we never store your email address)
• A random username we generate for you
• Deals you post (text, photo, link, location, prices)
• Your votes, reports and "expired" confirmations
• A random app ID for this install, used only to stop spam and abuse
No advertising IDs, no location tracking, no contacts, no third-party analytics or session recording. Browsing deals needs no account.
Only to run the app: showing deals, keeping one vote per person, reviewing posts, preventing fraud and sending the notifications you turn on.

On secure cloud servers (Supabase). Sign-in is handled by Google and Supabase Auth, which holds the account identity; our own database keeps only your username and an internal id. Push notifications are delivered by Google Firebase. Your login is stored encrypted on your phone.
Expired deals are deleted 90 days after they end, rejected deals after 30 days, reports after 90 days and feedback after 1 year. Deleting your account removes your data right away.
From your account page you can download all your data or permanently delete your account at any time. You can change your username too.

Post real deals only. No scams, spam, fake prices or duplicate posts. Deals are shared by users; always check details with the store before buying. You must be 18 or older, or use the app with a parent\'s permission.
Questions or requests? Use \"Feedback\" in the app menu and leave your email so we can reply.
